Influenza.see_doctor: If symptoms persist beyond a few days or worsen.
Influenza.self_care: Stay hydrated, rest, and use over-the-counter medicine.
Influenza.symptoms: Fever, chills, cough, sore throat, body aches, fatigue.
Influenza.causes: Influenza virus, spread through droplets from cough or sneeze.
Influenza.prevention: Annual flu vaccine, frequent hand washing, avoid close contact with sick individuals.

Migraine.see_doctor: If headaches are severe or frequent.
Migraine.self_care: Dark, quiet room, hydration, avoid triggers.
Migraine.symptoms: Severe headache, nausea, sensitivity to light and sound.
Migraine.causes: Genetic factors, hormonal changes, certain foods, stress.
Migraine.prevention: Avoid known triggers, regular sleep, stress management.
Migraine.treatment: Pain relief medications, preventive migraine drugs.

Heart Attack.self_care: Not applicable. Seek medical help right away.
Heart Attack.symptoms: Chest pain, shortness of breath, sweating, nausea.
Heart Attack.causes: Blocked blood flow to the heart, often due to plaque buildup in arteries.
Heart Attack.prevention: Healthy diet, regular exercise, no smoking, control blood pressure.
Heart Attack.treatment: Immediate emergency care, medications, possibly surgery.

Allergy.symptoms: Sneezing, itchy eyes, runny nose, skin rash.
Allergy.causes: Immune system overreaction to harmless substances like pollen or dust.
Allergy.prevention: Avoid exposure to allergens, use air filters, wear masks.

Food Poisoning.see_doctor: If symptoms last more than 2 days or include high fever.
Food Poisoning.causes: Bacteria, viruses, or toxins in contaminated food or water.
Food Poisoning.prevention: Wash hands, cook food thoroughly, avoid unpasteurized dairy.
Food Poisoning.treatment: Hydration, antibiotics if bacterial, over-the-counter anti-nausea medications.

Common Cold.see_doctor: Only if symptoms last more than 10 days.
Common Cold.symptoms: Runny nose, sore throat, cough, mild fever.
Common Cold.causes: Rhinoviruses, spread through airborne droplets or touching infected surfaces.
Common Cold.prevention: Frequent hand washing, avoid close contact with sick individuals.

Asthma.see_doctor: If breathing is difficult or frequent attacks occur.
Asthma.symptoms: Wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing.
Asthma.causes: Allergens, exercise, air pollution, respiratory infections.
Asthma.prevention: Avoid triggers, regular use of inhalers, proper medication.

Skin Allergy.symptoms: Itchy skin, red or inflamed rash.
Skin Allergy.causes: Allergic reaction to substances like pollen, insect bites, or certain fabrics.
Skin Allergy.prevention: Avoid allergens, use gentle skin care products.

Urinary Tract Infection.self_care: Drink plenty of water, avoid irritants.
Urinary Tract Infection.symptoms: Frequent urination, burning sensation, cloudy urine, pelvic pain.
Urinary Tract Infection.causes: Bacterial infection in the urinary tract, often caused by E. coli.
Urinary Tract Infection.prevention: Good hygiene, drink plenty of water, urinate after sex.

Diabetes.see_doctor: Yes, for medication and lifestyle guidance.
Diabetes.symptoms: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision.
Diabetes.causes: Insulin resistance or lack of insulin production.
Diabetes.prevention: Healthy diet, regular exercise, maintain healthy weight.
Diabetes.treatment: Insulin therapy, oral medications, lifestyle changes.

Arthritis.see_doctor: Yes, to manage pain and inflammation.
Arthritis.symptoms: Joint pain, stiffness, swelling, difficulty moving.
Arthritis.causes: Wear and tear on joints, autoimmune diseases.
Arthritis.treatment: Pain relievers, anti-inflammatory medications, physical therapy.

Tuberculosis.symptoms: Coughing up blood, weight loss, fever, night sweats.
Tuberculosis.causes: Mycobacterium tuberculosis, spread through airborne particles.
Tuberculosis.prevention: BCG vaccine, early detection, avoiding close contact with infected individuals.
Tuberculosis.treatment: Long-term antibiotics, isolation during active infection.

Dengue.see_doctor: Yes, especially if bleeding or dehydration occurs.
Dengue.symptoms: High fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, rash.
Dengue.causes: Mosquito-borne virus, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes.
Dengue.prevention: Avoid mosquito bites, use insect repellent, wear long sleeves.

Zika Virus.causes: Zika virus, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes.
Zika Virus.prevention: Avoid mosquito bites, use repellent, wear protective clothing.

Hepatitis.see_doctor: Yes, especially for jaundice or liver symptoms.
Hepatitis.causes: Viral infections, heavy alcohol use, autoimmune diseases.
Hepatitis.prevention: Hepatitis vaccine, avoid sharing needles, limit alcohol consumption.

COVID-19.symptoms: Fever, cough, shortness of breath, fatigue.
COVID-19.causes: SARS-CoV-2 virus, spread through respiratory droplets.
COVID-19.prevention: Wear masks, social distancing, hand hygiene, vaccination.
COVID-19.treatment: Supportive care, antivirals, oxygen therapy if severe.

Hypothyroidism.symptoms: Fatigue, weight gain, constipation, dry skin, sensitivity to cold.
Hypothyroidism.causes: Underactive thyroid gland, often due to autoimmune diseases or iodine deficiency.
Hypothyroidism.prevention: Regular thyroid function tests, adequate iodine intake.

Parkinson's Disease.prevention: No known prevention, but exercise and healthy diet help.
Parkinson's Disease.treatment: Medications, physical therapy, deep brain stimulation.

Alzheimer's Disease.see_doctor: Yes, for symptom management and support.
Alzheimer's Disease.symptoms: Memory loss, confusion, difficulty with tasks.
Alzheimer's Disease.prevention: Mental stimulation, healthy lifestyle, social engagement.
Alzheimer's Disease.treatment: Memory aids, medications to improve symptoms.

Diabetes Type 2.see_doctor: Yes, for medication and lifestyle changes.
Diabetes Type 2.symptoms: Increased thirst, frequent urination, blurred vision.
Diabetes Type 2.treatment: Lifestyle changes, oral medications, insulin if necessary.

Pneumonia.see_doctor: Yes, especially for elderly or infants.
Pneumonia.symptoms: Cough, fever, chest pain, difficulty breathing.
Pneumonia.causes: Bacterial, viral, or fungal infections in the lungs.
Pneumonia.prevention: Vaccination, good hygiene, avoiding sick people.

Stroke.symptoms: Sudden numbness or weakness, confusion, trouble speaking or seeing.
Stroke.causes: Blood flow disruption to the brain, either due to a blockage or bleeding.
Stroke.prevention: Control blood pressure, quit smoking, healthy diet, regular exercise.
Stroke.treatment: Emergency medical care, thrombolytic therapy, surgery.

Depression.symptoms: Sadness, hopelessness, lack of interest, fatigue.
Depression.causes: Genetics, brain chemistry, stressful life events.
Depression.prevention: Regular exercise, stress management, social support.

Strep Throat.symptoms: Sore throat, fever, difficulty swallowing, red tonsils.
Strep Throat.causes: Streptococcus bacteria, spread through respiratory droplets.
Strep Throat.prevention: Good hygiene, avoid close contact with infected individuals.

Ear Infection.symptoms: Ear pain, drainage from the ear, difficulty hearing.
Ear Infection.causes: Bacterial or viral infection in the middle ear.
Ear Infection.prevention: Avoid putting objects in the ear, manage allergies.
Ear Infection.treatment: Antibiotics if bacterial, pain relievers, warm compress.

Multiple Sclerosis.causes: Immune system attacks the nervous system.
Multiple Sclerosis.prevention: No known prevention, but early treatment helps.

Appendicitis.causes: Inflammation of the appendix, often due to blockage.

PCOS.symptoms: Irregular periods, excess hair growth, acne.
PCOS.prevention: Maintain a healthy weight, manage insulin levels.

Diabetic Ketoacidosis.causes: Severe insulin deficiency, often due to poorly controlled diabetes.

Sciatica.symptoms: Pain radiating from the lower back to the legs, numbness.
Sciatica.causes: Herniated disc, spinal stenosis, or nerve irritation.
Sciatica.prevention: Good posture, regular exercise, weight management.
Sciatica.treatment: Pain relievers, physical therapy, surgery if needed.
